user.description: Pick a device tracker to expose as a binary sensor. The original device tracker will be hidden. The binary sensor is on when the tracker reports 'home' and off otherwise.

data_description.entity_id: The device tracker to wrap. It will be hidden while this helper exists, and restored when the helper is deleted.
data_description.device_class: Controls how the binary sensor's on/off states are labelled and which icon is shown in the frontend.
